scripts.build: node scripts/setup-libmedia.mjs && node scripts/setup-provider-sandbox.mjs && tsc && vite build
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/setup-libmedia.mjs && node scripts/setup-provider-sandbox.mjs && vite --mode web
scripts.build:web: node scripts/setup-libmedia.mjs && node scripts/setup-provider-sandbox.mjs && tsc && vite build --mode web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:web: npm run build:web && playwright test --config playwright.web.config.mjs
scripts.test:extension: node scripts/setup-browser-host.mjs && node --test tests/extension-policy.test.mjs tests/extension-access.test.mjs tests/verification-host.test.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/setup-ffmpeg.mjs && node scripts/setup-proxies.mjs && node scripts/setup-libmpv.mjs
scripts.build:msix: npx -y cross-env VITE_IS_MS_STORE=true tauri-windows-bundle build --arch x64 --runner npm
scripts.build:msix:arm64: npx -y cross-env VITE_IS_MS_STORE=true tauri-windows-bundle build --arch arm64 --runner npm
scripts.test:security: node scripts/setup-browser-host.mjs && node scripts/setup-provider-sandbox.mjs && node --test tests/provider-url-policy.test.mjs tests/provider-security.test.mjs tests/native-provider-security.test.mjs scripts/tests/provider-axios-redirects.test.mjs && playwright test tests/browser/provider-security.spec.mjs
scripts.test:tv:browser: npm run build:webos && npm run build:amazon-vega && cargo build --locked --manifest-path tv/native-host/Cargo.toml && playwright test --config playwright.tv.config.mjs
